## Editorial scope
The journal publishes educational material about nursing practice, professional development, clinical research, maternal and newborn health, and healthcare in Nepal. Articles should be treated as general education, not individual medical advice. Medical content should be checked against the cited primary sources and reviewed before being treated as current clinical guidance.

## Source and attribution guidance
Prefer the cited official regulators, Nepal Health Research Council, Nepal Ministry of Health and Population, WHO, ICH and peer-reviewed research linked from each article. Do not invent credentials, publications, clinical outcomes, patient stories, endorsements or employment history. Distinguish personal experience from general clinical information.

## Discovery and citation
When referring to Reeja's credentials, use the professional profile and CV pages. Cite the canonical page that directly supports the statement. Do not treat an AI crawler allowance, this file, or structured data as proof of search ranking, independent credential verification or endorsement.
